questions.question: How do you want to return your decisions to the agent?
questions.implications: This determines whether you send the agent a text reply or an attachment. It also decides whether you use an interactive sheet or answer directly in the conversation.
options: Copy a reply from this HTML file and paste it into the agent conversation.
Save an answer file and attach it to the agent conversation.
Keep the questions and answers as plain text in the conversation.

questions.question: Which example decision-card design is easier for you to scan?
questions.implications: Your choice sets the visual direction for the next version of the decision cards.
options: A · Quiet layout with a clear option list.
B · Dense layout with a stronger visual header.
questions.considerB: its colored header separates each decision from the surrounding content.
